issue.title: SQL: Disallow non-collapsable subselects with ORDER BY

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Ordering an already pre-ordered and limited subselect is not allowed,
as such queries cannot be collapsed and translated into query DSL, but
the require an extra ordering step on top of the results returned
internally by the search/agg query.

Fixes: #71158
